IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BTACUP01.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY E: BATCH / FILE PROCESSING - SEQUENTIAL ACCOUNT UPDATE
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT ACCT-IN-FILE ASSIGN TO 'ACCTS.DAT'
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-FILE-STATUS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  ACCT-IN-FILE.
       01  FD-ACCT-RECORD.
           05  FD-ACCT-NUM         PIC X(10).
           05  FD-ACCT-TYPE        PIC X(2).
           05  FD-ACCT-BAL         PIC 9(7)V99.
           05  FD-OVERDRAFT-PROT   PIC X(1).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-FILE-STATUS          PIC X(2) VALUE '00'.
       01  WS-EOF-FLAG             PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-SUMMARY-COUNTERS.
           05  WS-RECORDS-READ     PIC 9(5) VALUE 00000.
           05  WS-TOTAL-FEES       PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0000000.00.
           05  WS-TOTAL-INTEREST   PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0000000.00.
       01  WS-RECORD-WORK-AREA.
           05  WS-CALC-FEE         PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.
           05  WS-CALC-INT         PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 00000.00.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-ACCOUNTS.
           PERFORM 1000-OPEN-FILES
           PERFORM 2000-READ-RECORD
           PERFORM 3000-PROCESS-LOOP UNTIL WS-EOF-FLAG = 'Y'
           PERFORM 4000-CLOSE-FILES
           GOBACK.

       1000-OPEN-FILES.
           OPEN INPUT ACCT-IN-FILE
           IF WS-FILE-STATUS NOT = '00'
               MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
           END-IF.

       2000-READ-RECORD.
           READ ACCT-IN-FILE INTO FD-ACCT-RECORD
               AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF-FLAG
               NOT AT END ADD 1 TO WS-RECORDS-READ
           END-READ.

       3000-PROCESS-LOOP.
           PERFORM 3100-APPLY-ACCOUNT-RULES
           PERFORM 2000-READ-RECORD.

       3100-APPLY-ACCOUNT-RULES.
           MOVE 0.00 TO WS-CALC-FEE
           MOVE 0.00 TO WS-CALC-INT
           IF FD-ACCT-BAL < 500.00
               IF FD-OVERDRAFT-PROT = 'Y'
                   MOVE 12.50 TO WS-CALC-FEE
               ELSE
                   MOVE 35.00 TO WS-CALC-FEE
               END-IF
           ELSE
               IF FD-ACCT-BAL >= 10000.00
                   COMPUTE WS-CALC-INT = FD-ACCT-BAL * 0.0025
               END-IF
           END-IF
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-FEES = WS-TOTAL-FEES + WS-CALC-FEE
           COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-INTEREST = WS-TOTAL-INTEREST + WS-CALC-INT.

       4000-CLOSE-FILES.
           CLOSE ACCT-IN-FILE.
```

                   ELSE

                       ELSE
                           MOVE 'FEE-ASSESSMENT' TO OUTCOME-ACTION
                       END-IF
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

           IF PHYSICAL-BRANCH AND TX-WITHDRAWAL

               ELSE
                   MOVE 0.00 TO FEES-LEVIED
               END-IF
           END-IF
           IF ONLINE-CHANNEL
               MOVE 0.00 TO FEES-LEVIED
           END-IF.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. INCLM01.
       AUTHOR. SYNTHETIC-CORPUS.
      * CATEGORY A: RULE-DENSE BUSINESS LOGIC - INSURANCE CLAIMS
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  CLAIM-INPUTS.
           05  CLAIM-TYPE          PIC X(10) VALUE 'AUTO'.
           05  CLAIM-AMOUNT        PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0012500.00.
           05  POLICY-AGE-MONTHS   PIC 9(3) VALUE 024.
           05  PREVIOUS-CLAIMS     PIC 9(2) VALUE 01.
           05  POLICE-REPORT-FILED PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
           05  DRIVER-AGE          PIC 9(3) VALUE 028.
           05  DEDUCTIBLE-PAID     PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
       01  CLAIM-OUTPUTS.
           05  APPROVAL-STATUS     PIC X(10) VALUE 'PENDING'.
           05  PAYOUT-AMOUNT       PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0000000.00.
           05  FRAUD-RISK-SCORE    PIC 9(3) VALUE 000.
           05  REQUIRES-ADJUSTER   PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  DENIAL-REASON       PIC X(30) VALUE SPACES.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-PROCESS-CLAIM.
           PERFORM 1000-EVALUATE-FRAUD-RISK
           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-ELIGIBILITY
           PERFORM 3000-CALCULATE-PAYOUT
           GOBACK.

       1000-EVALUATE-FRAUD-RISK.
           MOVE 0 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           IF POLICY-AGE-MONTHS < 6
               ADD 40 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF PREVIOUS-CLAIMS > 3
               ADD 30 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF POLICE-REPORT-FILED = 'N' AND CLAIM-AMOUNT > 5000.00
               ADD 25 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF DRIVER-AGE < 21 OR DRIVER-AGE > 75
               ADD 15 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF FRAUD-RISK-SCORE >= 50
               MOVE 'Y' TO REQUIRES-ADJUSTER
           END-IF.

       2000-DETERMINE-ELIGIBILITY.
           IF DEDUCTIBLE-PAID NOT = 'Y'
               MOVE 'DENIED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
               MOVE 'UNPAID DEDUCTIBLE' TO DENIAL-REASON
           ELSE
               IF CLAIM-AMOUNT <= 0.00
                   MOVE 'DENIED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
                   MOVE 'INVALID CLAIM AMOUNT' TO DENIAL-REASON
               ELSE
                   IF FRAUD-RISK-SCORE >= 70
                       MOVE 'REVIEW' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
                       MOVE 'HIGH FRAUD SCORE' TO DENIAL-REASON
                   ELSE
                       MOVE 'APPROVED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-IF.

       3000-CALCULATE-PAYOUT.
           IF APPROVAL-STATUS = 'APPROVED'
               IF CLAIM-TYPE = 'AUTO'
                   IF CLAIM-AMOUNT > 20000.00
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.90
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.95
                   END-IF
               ELSE
                   IF CLAIM-TYPE = 'PROPERTY'
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.85
                   ELSE
                       COMPUTE PAYOUT-AMOUNT = CLAIM-AMOUNT * 0.80
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           ELSE
               MOVE 0.00 TO PAYOUT-AMOUNT
           END-IF.
```

       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  CLAIM-INPUTS.
           05  CLAIM-TYPE          PIC X(10) VALUE 'AUTO'.
           05  CLAIM-AMOUNT        PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0012500.00.
           05  POLICY-AGE-MONTHS   PIC 9(3) VALUE 024.
           05  PREVIOUS-CLAIMS     PIC 9(2) VALUE 01.
           05  POLICE-REPORT-FILED PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
           05  DRIVER-AGE          PIC 9(3) VALUE 028.
           05  DEDUCTIBLE-PAID     PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
       01  CLAIM-OUTPUTS.
           05  APPROVAL-STATUS     PIC X(10) VALUE 'PENDING'.
           05  PAYOUT-AMOUNT       PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0000000.00.
           05  FRAUD-RISK-SCORE    PIC 9(3) VALUE 000.
           05  REQUIRES-ADJUSTER   PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
           05  DENIAL-REASON       PIC X(30) VALUE SPACES.

           PERFORM 2000-DETERMINE-ELIGIBILITY
           PERFORM 3000-CALCULATE-PAYOUT
           GOBACK.

       1000-EVALUATE-FRAUD-RISK.
           MOVE 0 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           IF POLICY-AGE-MONTHS < 6
               ADD 40 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF PREVIOUS-CLAIMS > 3
               ADD 30 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF POLICE-REPORT-FILED = 'N' AND CLAIM-AMOUNT > 5000.00
               ADD 25 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF DRIVER-AGE < 21 OR DRIVER-AGE > 75
               ADD 15 TO FRAUD-RISK-SCORE
           END-IF
           IF FRAUD-RISK-SCORE >= 50
               MOVE 'Y' TO REQUIRES-ADJUSTER
           END-IF.

       2000-DETERMINE-ELIGIBILITY.
           IF DEDUCTIBLE-PAID NOT = 'Y'
               MOVE 'DENIED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
               MOVE 'UNPAID DEDUCTIBLE' TO DENIAL-REASON
           ELSE
               IF CLAIM-AMOUNT <= 0.00
                   MOVE 'DENIED' TO APPROVAL-STATUS
                   MOVE 'INVALID CLAIM AMOUNT' TO DENIAL-REASON
               ELSE
